title: The Chess Game's Final Echo
next_chapter_hook: When the three wills completed an unprecedented fusion in the depths of Chen Ji's divine soul, the chessboard that had been watched by the Eye of Heaven for countless years finally faced the counterattack of the chess player—and this was merely the prelude to a greater storm.

text.content:
Three breaths.

Chen Ji felt his divine soul being torn apart by three distinctly different forces simultaneously—the golden characters of the Tianji Record churned in his Mental Sea like boiling magma, the desolate whispers of the ancient will pierced his marrow like an ancient cold wind, and the cold, merciless pressure of the Heavenly Eye consciousness came crushing down upon his core consciousness with the force to overwhelm everything.

"This is your end, Chen Ji." The voice came from nowhere and everywhere, yet it was like Heaven itself passing judgment. "You thought you escaped the chessboard, but you never realized you were always my most perfect piece."

A strand of blood trickled from the corner of Chen Ji's mouth, his soul's edges already beginning to blur. Yet amid the violent tremors, his consciousness miraculously maintained a thread of clarity—because he saw it. Within three breaths, he saw three possibilities.

First breath—resist with all might.

The Turtle Shell Fragment in his Mental Sea quivered violently, those fragmented runes attempting to construct a barrier to isolate the Heavenly Eye's erosion. But Chen Ji clearly saw that this path led to his soul being burned away. His Heavenly Fate value was depleting at a terrifying rate—not consumption, but overdraft.

"Your Tianji Record is merely a scrap stolen from my chessboard." The voice carried absolute arrogance. "How dare you display your petty skills before me?"

Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record lamenting. Those golden characters were shattering piece by piece, becoming a burden to his soul rather than power.

dialogue.content: "Stolen?" Chen Ji's voice echoed in his Mental Sea, carrying a诡异的 smile. "If it truly belonged to you, why can I see futures you cannot see?"

text.content:
Second breath—borrow power.

The awakening degree of the ancient will had deepened further during the previous conflict. The power sleeping deep within Chen Ji's bloodline was stirring. It had once been the master of this world, and even as merely a remnant soul, it possessed the foundation to confront the Heavenly Eye consciousness.

But borrowing power meant exchange. The awakening of the ancient will would inevitably bring uncontrollable side effects—Chen Ji might lose himself, replaced by the ancient will.

"You are hesitating." The Heavenly Eye consciousness's voice suddenly turned bone-cold. "Did you think there was a third path?"

Third breath—fusion.

This was a path the Tianji Record had never displayed. In his foresight, Chen Ji saw a blurred image: three forces, after extreme conflict, instead of destroying each other, began to interweave in some profound, mysterious way.

Gold, pale, black.

Three colors probed, collided, and compromised within the chaos.

But that image was too blurred, the possibility of success shrouded in layers of mist—and that mist's aura, Chen Ji knew intimately.

It was his sister Chen Nian's aura.

Those golden characters no longer attempted to defend, but transformed into countless sharp blades, rolling back toward the Heavenly Eye consciousness. "You shouldn't underestimate anyone who tries to jump out of the chessboard." His voice became hoarse under the pressure, yet showed no signs of retreat.

dialogue.content: "A flea trying to shake a tree." The Heavenly Eye consciousness's voice was cold without any emotional fluctuation. "Do you think this can injure me? How laughable."

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes and voluntarily opened the door sealed for countless ages in his bloodline. The vast, primeval aura flooded into his divine soul like a breaching flood—the ancient roar made his seven orifices bleed—but that power's magnificence caused the Heavenly Eye's pressure to falter.

dialogue.content: "No!" Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out in horror within the remnant soul. "The ancient will isn't meant to be used this way! Chen Ji, you will—" Before the words finished, they were drowned by that primeval force.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and made the most insane decision. He no longer tried to suppress any of the forces, but completely opened his Divine Soul, allowing three wills to surge in simultaneously. In that instant, golden, pale, and black light collided violently within his Mental Sea—

Intense pain tore through Chen Ji's consciousness. The three forces waged a war without smoke in the depths of his Divine Soul, every collision bringing vibrations from the depths of his soul. The golden characters entwined with the vast ancient meaning, yet were incompatible with the jet-black Heavenly Eye power. The three consciousnesses clashed in his Mental Sea, tearing his already tottering Divine Soul to pieces. But within this chaos, Chen Ji saw a possibility—the fog blocking foresight was dissipating, Chen Nian's aura becoming clear. "Chen Nian..." he murmured, his consciousness desperately searching for that sliver of life at the edge of collapse.

dialogue.content: "How dare you..." For the first time, the Heavenly Eye Consciousness's voice wavered, disbelief seeping through its cold tone, "You want to fuse with this one's power? Foolish! This is a desecration of the Heavenly Dao!"

text.content: Chen Ji felt the Heavenly Eye Consciousness counterattacking madly, the overwhelming pressure becoming violent and chaotic. It tried to shatter his Divine Soul before he could complete the fusion. But it was too late. In the final moment before his consciousness completely dissolved, Chen Ji finally grasped that fleeting opportunity—he saw it. The point where the three powers converged, the blurry future protected by Chen Nian's aura. "So that's how it is..." A smile curved his lips, "You've always wanted to cultivate me into the perfect chess piece, not knowing—chess pieces can also grow."

text.content: Chen Ji did not choose any side as dominant. He transformed his divine soul into a crucible, allowing the golden, pallid, and black powers to struggle, probe, and ultimately compromise within it. The vastness of the ancient will, the profundity of the Tianji Record, and the coldness of the Heavenly Eye consciousness slowly intertwined into an unprecedented pattern within this crucible.

dialogue.content: In that blurry vision, a familiar figure slowly appeared—Chen Nian. She stood at the crossroads of fate, guarding this most dangerous path in her own way. 'Brother...' her voice echoed across time and space, 'I knew you wouldn't give up.'

text.content:
The fusion process was far more prolonged and agonizing than Chen Ji had imagined. Each second stretched like a century, and every collision of consciousness made him feel his divine soul being repeatedly forged.

But he did not retreat.

Because in the depths of that chaos, he saw Chen Nian's smile. The prophecy obscured by the power of the Heavenly Fate Key was becoming clearer—she was alive, somehow assisting him.

'Wait for me.' Chen Ji silently pledged, 'This time, I'll save you.'

dialogue.content: 'You think you can succeed?' The Heavenly Eye consciousness's voice turned distorted and manic, 'This One has existed for countless years, witnessing countless so-called geniuses rise and fall. You are merely another—'

text.content:
'Silence.'

Chen Ji opened his eyes, three colors swirling in his gaze—golden, pallid, and black. The overwhelming pressure that once dominated now seemed dim and insignificant.

The Heavenly Eye consciousness fell silent.

This was its first silence.

'Congratulations, Chen Ji.' When the voice spoke again, it had regained its initial coldness, though a subtle wariness now lingered. 'You've forged a path no predecessor ever took. But do you believe this marks the end?'

'On the chessboard of heaven's dao, there are no true victors.'

text.content: Chen Ji did not grant his opponent a moment's respite. The three-colored light blazed magnificently within the Mental Sea, transforming into a brilliant sword light aimed directly at the core of the Heavenly Eye consciousness. 'You've been watching me for so long,' his voice cold as frost, 'now it's my turn.'

The sword light pierced through layers of void but halted abruptly before reaching the Heavenly Eye consciousness's main body. An invisible barrier effortlessly deflected that world-destroying strike. The Heavenly Eye consciousness's voice carried a hint of mockery: 'Is this all the strength you have? Come back when you've truly matured.'

dialogue.content: 'Well done.' Mo Xiansheng's voice carried rare praise, 'What you need most now is time. The Trivalent Unification constitution requires at least forty-nine days to fully stabilize; until then, do not act rashly.'

text.content: Chen Ji's voice rang out in the void, carrying an unprecedented composure: 'Senior Heavenly Eye, we both know that continuing this fight will only result in mutual destruction. Why don't we talk— for instance, about my sister's whereabouts?'

dialogue.content:
Silence.

A long, endless silence.

Then that voice returned, yet carrying a strange undertone: 'Chen Nian? Interesting, you actually know of her existence... Very well, this one can tell you some things, but in exchange—you must agree to this one's condition.'

text.content:
Chen Ji did not answer immediately. He was waiting.

The Heavenly Eye consciousness far exceeded his imagination. The 'condition' it mentioned was likely a trap. But the news about Chen Nian was too important to him— even just a single clue, he was unwilling to let slip.

This was his greatest weakness.

It was also his greatest strength.

Because there was someone he wished to protect, he had nothing to fear.

'This one's condition is simple.' The Heavenly Eye consciousness's voice carried some unfathomable emotion, 'When Volume Five opens, you will see her. By then, you will naturally understand this one's meaning.'

As the words fell, the pressure笼罩在陈机识海中的imposing彻底消散。The Heavenly Eye consciousness retreated— not defeated, but voluntarily withdrawing.

This made Chen Ji's heart ring with alarm.

The Eye of Heaven never acts without profit. Its promise to share news about Chen Nian must be because doing so benefited its chess game more.

But he had no choice.

For his sister, he was willing to make a pact with the tiger.

Peace returned to the Mental Sea, leaving only the faint glow of the Tianji Record and the low breathing of the ancient will. Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes to find himself still sitting cross-legged at the Cliff Edge of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain.

The starry sky above remained brilliant, as if nothing had happened.

But he knew everything had changed.

In his divine soul, an unprecedented structure had emerged— the embryo of Three Origins Unification. Gold, pallor, and black three types of power circled each other in his Mental Sea, forming a subtle trinity cycle.

This was his capital to resist the Heavenly Way.

It was also the key to finding Chen Nian.

dialogue.content:
'Three Origins Unification...' Mo Xiansheng's voice emerged from the remnant soul, carrying a trace of emotion, 'This is a realm even the creator of the Tianji Record never reached. You traversed in three days what others cannot walk in a lifetime.'

He paused, his tone becoming serious: 'But this is not an ending, but a beginning. The Heavenly Eye consciousness retreated, but that doesn't mean it gave up. It is waiting— waiting for you to grow strong enough to become its true chess piece.'

Chen Ji stood up, his gaze falling upon the distant horizon.

'Then let it wait.' His voice was calm yet firm, 'Wait until it discovers that I am no longer a piece on its chessboard, but a new Chess Player.'

text.content:
The night wind brushed across Chen Ji's face, carrying the mountain's distinctive chill. His divine sense gently swept through his body, confirming that the Three Origins Unification structure was stably operating. The precarious Tianji Record Fragment now quietly floated in the depths of his Mental Sea, radiating unprecedented luster.

He knew his strength had undergone a qualitative leap. The fusion of three powers not only granted him Combat Power far beyond his peers, but more importantly— he could finally clearly 'see' those strands of fate that had been obscured by Chen Nian's aura.

His sister's whereabouts were gradually surfacing.

The bells of Tianqing Sect rang in the distant dawn, heralding another daybreak. Chen Ji took a deep breath and turned to gaze at the sect he had lived in for many years.

Elder Ling Yuan was currently in seclusion— but Chen Ji knew that was merely the surface. That last-generation inheritance candidate 'abandoned' by the Tianji Record had never ceased his covetousness toward the Tianji Record.

And now, he had sufficient strength to respond.

'Chen Ji.'

A clear, cold voice came from behind. Chen Ji turned to see Su Qingyao standing not far away, her figure in the moonlight like a plum blossom enduring frost. Her gaze lingered on him for a moment, her brow slightly furrowing.

'Your aura... has changed.'

Her intuition was as sharp as ever. Chen Ji's heart stirred within him, yet he did not reveal it— Su Qingyao was the only person who had noticed his abnormality, yet also one of the people he was most unwilling to hurt.

'Some fortuitous encounter,' he said lightly, 'obtained by chance.'

Su Qingyao stared at him for three breaths, then sighed softly: 'You always do this. Clearly harboring earth-shaking secrets, yet insisting on wearing an innocent mask.'

She turned and left, her voice drifting with the wind: 'Next time there's danger, remember to call me. As the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, if I can't protect a Servant Disciple, wouldn't that be a laughingstock?'

Chen Ji watched her departing figure, the corners of his lips lifting slightly.

This woman...

When the three wills completed an unprecedented fusion within Chen Ji's divine soul, the chessboard that had been observed by the Heavenly Eye for countless ages finally welcomed the counterattack of the Chess Player— and this was merely the prelude to a greater storm.

The text on the Tianji Record Fragment was slowly changing. Those originally vague symbols gradually revealed new meanings. Mo Xiansheng said this was the new ability brought by Three Origins Unification— he could finally glimpse further into the distant past and farther into the distant future.

And in the deepest part of his divine soul, Chen Nian's fuzzy figure was becoming increasingly clear. She stood before a massive stone gate, surrounded by endless darkness and starlight.

'Brother, I'm waiting for you.' Her voice crossed through time and space, 'Volume Five... I will let you find me.'

Chen Ji clenched his fists tightly.

Volume Five.

He couldn't wait any longer.
